comments.what: The parser drops the last token when the input ends without a newline.
comments.why: Files saved by editors that omit the final newline lose their last field, so the import silently truncates data.
comments.fix: Flush the pending token after the scan loop ends, before returning the result.
comments.source: correctness agent (also flagged by: test-quality agent)

comments.what: The handler logs the full request body, including the session token.
comments.why: Anyone with read access to the logs can replay a user session.
comments.fix: Log only the request path and status, or redact the `Authorization` header before logging.
